capabilities: Read EPUB, TXT, PDF and CBZ books
Ask AI questions about a book
Track reading stats and review with flashcards
extras: Freemium: free base edition; Pro license unlocks PDF, comics, advanced AI, stats and offline audio. Community-market listing was pending review at the time of the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read and annotate books, PDFs or comics alongside notes.

relations.evidence: Embeddings come from the bz (second brain) plugin: without it there is no vector search

summary: Ebook reader for Obsidian with a shelf, EPUB/TXT/PDF/comic reading, highlights, AI Q&A, text-to-speech and local data.
